description: On a wooden harbour pier at night under a full moon, a young woman in a black sleeveless bodysuit, dripping wet, walks forward holding up an open iron shackle on a long chain and shouting in triumph, her breath steaming. A heap of chains, a black box and an orange rope lie on the boards behind her. Friends cheer and hug, a man in a top hat and waistcoat points at her, and a young woman in a red jacket holds up a foil blanket, under strings of lights and an old street lamp.
